$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services pack composed with a luxury coastal residential builder content seed (Meridian Coastal, Malibu), a graphite brand, and the horizon register. Everything else — builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Luxury coastal residential builder
description: A coastal builder's site as a quiet masthead: the name set wide over a ruled line of places and the bluff-top residence as a panorama, the residences as a rail of frames, three numbers between rules, one design story beside its photograph, and a private inquiry form — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so this appointments seed replaces the base pack's at compose and mirrors THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twin) — the composed template's booking widget and Manage calendar open on this team's own week, not the base demo business's.

types.name: Introductory call
types.description: The site, the architect, and the timeline — a first conversation with a principal.

types.name: Site walk
types.description: A principal walks the land with you: geology, setbacks, views, and access.

theme.$comment: Graphite as the brand: on the horizon register the accent is the ink of the links, rules, and the one quiet ask, so a rebrand re-inks the masthead without re-shooting the residences. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-skins the pages and the app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared servicesShell chrome to the burger overlay (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop): the name alone at the top. mode light opens on the white stock (theme merges shallowly).

landing.$comment: The pin: the horizon register and the masthead home — the name set wide over the ruled coast line and the bluff as a panorama (masthead-overlay; the register lifts the name off the photograph), the residences as a rail of frames (the seed's lookbook as media-rail), the three numbers (the seed's home.proofMetrics), the design story beside the pool (the seed's feature as content-split media-left), and the closing ask. The seed hides the home services grid (home.serviceGrid). The residences page opens on the residences grid over the site-to-residence comparisons; the other pages keep the base's skeletons, with the numbers on home rather than about. resolveCatalog puts these in place of the base's pages.
